issues.legal_issue: Waiver of a statutory pre-emption right does not require a contract, agreement, or consideration when the claimant has acquiesced in the sale by a positive act relinquishing that right.
material_facts: The appellant sought pre-emption of land sold to the respondent under the applicable tenancy legislation.
The respondent alleged that the appellant had acted as a broker in the sale and received brokerage, thereby waiving the pre-emption right.
The trial court allowed the pre-emption claim, but the appellate court found that the right had been waived; the High Court declined to disturb that finding.
The appellant argued that waiver required a contract and consideration, neither of which had been established.
issues.conclusion: A pre-emption right may be waived without a contract, agreement, or consideration; acquiescence in the sale by a positive act relinquishing the right forfeits it. The Court found no reason to disturb the finding of waiver and dismissed the appeal.
issues.legal_principle: Under Indian law, consideration or an agreement is not necessary to constitute waiver. Section 63 of the Indian Contract Act permits a promisee to dispense with or remit performance, and Waman Shriniwas Kini v. Ratilal Bhagwandas & Co. describes waiver as abandonment of a right and an intention not to insist upon it. In pre-emption law, acquiescence in a sale through a positive act amounting to relinquishment forfeits the right; this principle is based mainly on Mohammedan jurisprudence. Section 26F of the Bengal Tenancy Act provides the statutory pre-emption context. The Court rejected the contention based on Dawson’s Bank Ltd. v. Nippon Menkwa Kabushiki Kaisha that waiver here had to be contractual.

predicates.preemption_claim: A person asserts a right to pre-empt a sale of property.
predicates.positive_act_relinquishing_right: The person asserting pre-emption acquiesces in the sale through a positive act that relinquishes the asserted right.
predicates.preemptive_right_forfeited_without_contr: The pre-emption right is forfeited even though no contract, agreement, or consideration is required to effect the waiver.

issues.definition: When a person asserting pre-emption acquiesces in the sale through a positive act relinquishing that right, the right is forfeited without a contract or consideration.
